LanguageData.WFL_Military_VanguardBonus: Breaker: closes fast and breaks the enemy's line, going for their shooters. Moves 20% faster while closing on an enemy and hits 10% harder once engaged. Weakness: Harder to dodge with: dodge falls 15% while charging.
LanguageData.WFL_Military_GuardianBonus: Anchor: holds the line and covers wounded and downed friends. Takes 15% less damage while covering an ally. Weakness: Moves 8% slower and kills no faster than anyone.
LanguageData.WFL_Military_DuelistBonus: Skirmisher: wins a one-on-one and picks off an enemy who has strayed from the pack. Hits 15% better and dodges 20% better with one enemy near. Weakness: Dodge falls 15% once three or more are close.
LanguageData.WFL_Military_MarksmanBonus: Precision: steady, accurate fire at the middle distance on whoever is exposed. 10% more accurate between 12 and 30 cells; prefers exposed and armed targets. Weakness: 10% less accurate inside 6 cells.
LanguageData.WFL_Military_GunnerBonus: Suppression: volume of fire that keeps the enemy's heads down at short range. Weapon cooldown 15% shorter (fires more often) and 5% more accurate within 12 cells; prefers the nearest enemy. Weakness: 8% less accurate beyond 20 cells.
LanguageData.WFL_Military_SniperBonus: Overwatch: patient long-range kills on the enemy's most dangerous. 15% more accurate beyond 25 cells once set up (not moving); prefers the most dangerous target. Weakness: 25% slower to aim, and 15% less accurate inside 10 cells.
LanguageData.WFL_Military_FieldMedicBonus: Medic: keeps the line standing, tending the fallen where they lie. Needs a Community Care Doctor qualification as well as Soldier or Ranger. Tends 15% faster with a friend down within 6 cells. Weakness: fights worse, 10% less accurate and 10% worse at landing a melee blow.
LanguageData.WFL_Military_OfficerBonus: Commander: coordinates the line and steadies those near. Soldiers within 10 cells of them shoot and strike 5% better in a fight (it does not stack). Weakness: directs rather than fights, 8% less accurate and 8% worse at dodging.
LanguageData.WFL_Military_ByThreat: (raised by a threat; it stands down by itself once the map has been calm for an hour)
LanguageData.WFL_Military_AlertExplain_Yellow: Heightened watch: patrols, lookout and guard. Open Community, Military to change the level.
LanguageData.WFL_Military_AlertExplain_Red: Defensive positions. Serving soldiers are drafted and sent to their posts. Open Community, Military to change the level. Anything you order yourself stands.
LanguageData.WFL_Military_AutoRed: Raise Red automatically when hostiles appear
LanguageData.WFL_Military_AutoRedTip: When hostiles appear on the map the colony goes to Red by itself, then drops back to the level you set after an hour without any. Only pawns you have assigned a Military role are drafted, and each is handled once, so any order you give afterwards stands.
LanguageData.WFL_Military_RedRaised: Hostiles sighted: Red alert. Serving soldiers are going to their posts.
LanguageData.WFL_Military_StoodDown: The threat has passed. Military alert is now {0}.
LanguageData.WFL_Military_PostHomeOnly: Posts can only be placed on a home map.
LanguageData.WFL_Military_TrainingYardDesc: Paint an area where soldiers drill, spar and practise.
LanguageData.WFL_Military_DutiesOnTip: Serving soldiers who are idle in their Work hours, rested and not needed elsewhere do their duty: drill, spar, range practice, first aid or muster at Normal; patrol, lookout and gate guard at Yellow. Never at Red or while hostiles are about, and no more than half of them at once. Any need or order of yours interrupts a duty.
LanguageData.WFL_Military_Volunteers: Other colonists may join the training in their free time
LanguageData.WFL_Military_VolunteersTip: A colonist who is not a soldier may join a drill or range practice that is already running, but only in free time (never work time), and only if they have a passion for Melee or Shooting or a soldier in the family. Combat training opens at 13.
LanguageData.WFL_Military_DutiesStatus: {0} on duty now. Training Yard: {1} cells.
LanguageData.WFL_Military_NoYard: No Training Yard is painted, so there is nowhere to drill, spar or practise. Paint one under Architect, Zone.
LanguageData.WFL_Military_DutiesHelp: Duties earn experience. A specialist earns toward their own specialty. A soldier who has earned a branch practises the specialty their skills and experience put them nearest to, which is how a specialty is earned before it can be assigned. A Recruit builds toward the branch of their better skill.
LanguageData.WFL_Military_AlertHelp: Normal is routine and training. Yellow is a heightened watch: patrols, lookouts and guards. Red sends serving soldiers to defensive positions: they are drafted and sent to a position of their own type first (Melee for the Soldier branch, Ranged for the Ranger branch), then a Mixed one, then the Rally point. Field Medics, Officers and Recruits prefer Mixed. A soldier you have posted to a position goes there. With no positions placed, nobody is sent anywhere. At stand-down only the soldiers drafted by Red are undrafted.
LanguageData.WFL_Military_PlacePostDesc: Place a Melee, Ranged or Mixed defensive position, or the Rally point. Soldiers on Red alert go to them.
LanguageData.WFL_Military_RemovePost: Remove a position or patrol spot
LanguageData.WFL_Military_RemovePostDesc: Take a Military position or patrol spot away.
LanguageData.WFL_Military_NoPostsHint: No defensive positions or patrol spots are placed, so there is no lookout, gate guard or route to patrol.
LanguageData.WFL_Military_PostDesc_Melee: for the Soldier branch: Vanguards, Guardians and Duelists
LanguageData.WFL_Military_PostDesc_Ranged: for the Ranger branch: Marksmen, Gunners and Snipers (try high ground)
LanguageData.WFL_Military_PostDesc_Mixed: anyone: Field Medics, Officers and Recruits prefer it, and others take it when their own type is full
LanguageData.WFL_Military_GroupsHelp: Groups and subgroups from Wil's Group Organization. Soldiers in a group, and in its subgroups, can be posted together to a patrol route or a position. Groups and their members are managed in that mod; here they are only read.
LanguageData.WFL_Military_NoGroups: No groups yet. Make them with Wil's Group Organization.
LanguageData.WFL_Military_GroupPostTip: Post all {0} serving soldiers of this group (and its subgroups) to a patrol route or position.
LanguageData.WFL_Military_PositionsHelp: Where soldiers stand at Red. Place Melee, Ranged and Mixed positions and the Rally point. A typed position holds one soldier; the Rally point is shared. You can post a soldier to a position on the Soldiers tab.
LanguageData.WFL_Military_RoutesHelp: A patrol walks the spots of one route, in an order worked out automatically, for about one duty block and the next patrol continues where it stopped, so a long route is covered over several patrols. A soldier walks the spots of their own type and Mixed spots, and the route walked least recently. A soldier posted to a route walks all of it.
LanguageData.WFL_Military_NoRoutes: No routes yet. Add one, then place patrol spots in it.
LanguageData.WFL_Military_PlaceSpotDesc: Place a patrol spot in a route (choose the route, or a new one, and the type).
LanguageData.WFL_Military_YardHelp: Where soldiers drill, spar, practise at the range and stand by with first aid. One type of yard; paint as many as you like.
LanguageData.WFL_Military_SoldiersHelp: Everyone you have assigned a Military role: their role, the specialty their duties are counting toward, what they are doing and where, and where they are posted. Click a name to go to them.
LanguageData.WFL_Military_NoSoldiers: Nobody is assigned a Military role yet. Assign roles on the Professions page.
LanguageData.WFL_Military_PostingTip: Choose where this soldier is posted. Automatic means the nearest suitable route or position of their type.
LanguageData.WFL_Military_ArmoryDesc: Paint a stockpile for the military's weapons and armour. When the alert is Yellow or Red, a soldier with no suitable weapon takes the best one from it.
LanguageData.WFL_Military_ArmoryStatus: {0} Armory zones holding {1} melee and {2} ranged weapons.
LanguageData.WFL_Military_ArmoryNeeding: {0} serving soldiers have no suitable weapon right now.
LanguageData.WFL_Military_ArmoryHelp: An Armory is an ordinary stockpile with its filter set to weapons and armour (change it like any stockpile) that haulers will fill. At Yellow, and when Red is raised, a serving soldier with no suitable weapon (none, or the wrong kind: a melee weapon for a Ranger, a ranged one for a Soldier) goes and takes the best one: the highest quality of the right kind, ties by value. Support and Recruits take the best of any kind. They keep it. Nobody who already holds a suitable weapon is touched, and a soldier you had already drafted is never sent.
LanguageData.WFL_Military_ButtonTip: Military alert: {0}{1}. Click to set {2}. Right-click for a menu.
LanguageData.WFL_Military_ShowPositionsTip: Show or hide the placed positions and patrol routes on the map. They always show while you place them or have the Military menu open.
LanguageData.WFL_Need_Yard: A training yard for the soldiers
